signal: Trainual rolled out SCORM support and onboarding training-path templates in 2025, building on its strategic partnership with Entrepreneurs' Organization (15,000+ leaders across 61 countries).

email.body1:
Susannah, saw Trainual ship SCORM support and the onboarding training-path templates this year, on top of the EO partnership.

A partner network like EO usually surfaces more co-sell accounts than the team can work by hand, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trainual's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Susannah, quick follow-up for Trainual.

The hard part of partnerships is not the deals, it is covering every co-sell account with personal, research-backed outreach before they go cold. Most teams cannot say how much partner-sourced pipeline they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many co-sell meetings Trainual needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Susannah, last bit of proof for Trainual.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other partnership-led teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Susannah, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Building out a partner motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays for your partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to Trainual either way.
